scene clearnightsky
And so one more war comes to an end...but you weren’t there to see any of it this time.
lines.zh: 于是又一场战争落下帷幕……但这一次，你并没有亲眼见证其中的任何一部分。

lines.en: Because you were fighting your own battle.
lines.zh: 因为你在打属于你自己的那场仗。

lines.en: You were neck deep in wanting something, trying to keep your chin up so you wouldn’t accidentally let too much of that desire in to change the way your organs work.
lines.zh: 你深陷于某种渴望之中，拼命把下巴抬高，好让自己不至于一不小心放进太多欲望，改变你器官的运作方式。

lines.en: But you were failing.
lines.zh: 但你正在失败。

lines.en: Even now, you’re failing — sitting at a kitchen table with someone whose existence you ignored just yesterday because she reminds you too much of someone else.
lines.zh: 即便此刻，你也正在失败——坐在厨房的餐桌旁，对面是一个你昨天还对她视而不见的人，只因为她让你太容易想起另一个人。

lines.en: But what if it was always like that?
lines.zh: 可如果一直都是这样呢？

lines.en: What if that’s how she looked at first too? A reminder of someone else you were forced to let go of while you were still trying to figure out how to use your hands.
lines.zh: 如果她当初看起来也是这样呢？也是某个人的影子——一个你还没学会怎么使用自己的双手时，就被迫放手的人的影子。

lines.en: Will every girl you meet and every girl you fall for follow the same trajectory? Just one more step on a never-ending staircase, leading somewhere you don’t even know yet?
lines.zh: 你遇到的每一个女孩、你爱上的每一个女孩，都会沿着同样的轨迹走下去吗？都只是那条永无止境的阶梯上的一级，通往一个你自己都还不知道的地方？

lines.en: Does what’s at the top even matter?
lines.zh: 顶上有什么，真的还重要吗？

lines.en: Do you hate the way your choices are judged like this?
lines.zh: 你讨厌自己的选择被人这样审视吗？

lines.en: See, that’s the problem with things like stairs — it’s that things like stares will always make you trip.
lines.zh: 瞧，阶梯这种东西的问题就在这里——那些目光总会让你绊倒。

lines.en: You might want to know what’s at the top, but you also might be content with just walking up and down until your knees buckle and your descent becomes less of a choice and more of a result.
lines.zh: 你可能想知道顶上有什么，但你也可能会满足于就这么上上下下地走，直到膝盖发软，直到你的坠落不再是一种选择，而只是一种结果。

lines.en: Each step is a reminder of the one before it.
lines.zh: 每一级台阶都在提醒你它前面的那一级。

lines.en: And every time you grip that railing to pull yourself up, all you’re really doing is delaying the inevitable.
lines.zh: 而每当你抓住扶手把自己拽上去，你真正做的不过是推迟那不可避免的结局。

lines.en: There is nothing at the top.
lines.zh: 顶上什么都没有。

lines.en: There is nothing at the bottom.
lines.zh: 底下什么也没有。

lines.en: You’ll be trapped in here forever until there’s a reason for you to leave.
lines.zh: 你会永远被困在这里，直到出现一个让你离开的理由。

lines.en: scene meetandfuck1
And now for something completely different.
lines.zh: 接下来是完全不同的内容。

lines.en: : First and foremost, I’d like to thank you all for taking the time out of your very busy schedules to attend the first annual Nodokathon.
lines.zh: : 首先，我要感谢各位从百忙之中抽出时间，来参加第一届 Nodokathon。

lines.en: : I’m your host, Nodoka Nagasawa. But, before we get into the details of exactly what this event will entail, please allow me to apologize for the way I conducted myself earlier.
lines.zh: : 我是主持人 Nodoka Nagasawa。不过，在详细说明本次活动的内容之前，请允许我先为早些时候的失态向各位致歉。

lines.en: : It appears that I have said something that may have made several people uncomfortable. And, while it’s been pointed out to me that this happens rather often, I assure you that my intentions have never been to harm.
lines.zh: : 看来我说了一些可能让几位感到不适的话。虽然有人指出这种事在我身上发生得相当频繁，但我向各位保证，我从未有过伤人的意图。

lines.en: : You see, I pride myself as a-
lines.zh: : 要知道，我一向以自己是——

lines.en: : Yeah, yeah, yeah. We don’t care what you said. Just get on with the fun part.
lines.zh: : 行了行了行了。我们才不在乎你说了什么。赶紧进入好玩的部分吧。

lines.en: scene meetandfuck2
: Speak for yourself, Kirin. You weren’t even there.
lines.zh: : 那是你自己的想法，Kirin。你当时根本不在场。

lines.en: : Yeah, which is exactly why I don’t care. Nodoka says weird shit all the time. It’s the fact that she’s apologizing for it that’s really weird.
lines.zh: : 对啊，所以我才不在乎。Nodoka 说怪话又不是一天两天了。真正奇怪的是她居然会为此道歉。

lines.en: : Wait, so what happened exactly? What did Nodoka say?
lines.zh: : 等等，所以到底发生了什么？Nodoka 说了什么？

lines.en: : I’m sure you’ll hear about it sooner or later. What I really want to know is why the six of us were chosen for this “Nodokathon” thing.
lines.zh: : 你早晚都会听说的。我真正想知道的是，为什么我们六个人会被挑中来参加这个 Nodokathon。

lines.en: : Is it really just the six of us? I was under the impression everybody got one of those forms since Noriko and I both did.
lines.zh: : 真的只有我们六个吗？我印象里每个人都应该收到了那种表格，因为 Noriko 和我都收到了。

lines.en: : Several other students were invited, but the six of you were the only ones who submitted their forms — which I am very thankful for as it keeps things even.
lines.zh: : 我还邀请了其他几位学生，但只有你们六个交回了表格——对此我非常感激，因为这样人数刚好凑得整齐。

lines.en: : There is no level too difficult for the Emerald Guardian of the Crystal Forest! And my presence here is naught but a testament to such a decree!
lines.zh: : 没有什么关卡能难倒水晶森林的翡翠守护者！而我的到场，正是这一宣言的最佳证明！

lines.en: scene meetandfuck3
: So it wasn’t the disclaimer regarding “depravity and lasciviousness” that made you submit your application? It was the “challenge” part?

lines.en: : Hey, you’re no better than me! We’re both perverts and everyone here is aware of that!

lines.en: : Sana’s the one we should be concerned about, if anything. She’s the last girl I expected to turn up here.

lines.en: : I still don’t really...understand what’s happening, so...
lines.zh: : 我还是有点……搞不清现在是什么情况，所以……

lines.zh: : 那么，请允许我说明一下。

lines.en: scene meetandfuck4

lines.en: : By appearing here and submitting your participation forms, you have consented to keep all that happens within this room a secret from anyone who did not attend. Is that clear?
lines.zh: : 你们来到这里并交上参与表格，就意味着同意对这个房间里发生的一切保密，不向任何未到场的人透露。这一点清楚了吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, that’s what makes it exciting.
lines.zh: : 对啊，刺激就刺激在这里。

lines.en: : And exciting it shall be, Kirin- for the six of you were invited as I believe you’ll be capable of keeping this contest classified from those who would not understand it.

lines.en: scene meetandfuck5

lines.en: : These names will be drawn to see who among you will be competing in three separate competitions, each one of increasing intensity.

lines.en: : Anything that happens here will simply...stop existing once the competition comes to an end. And any memories that have been made along the way are yours to keep.
lines.zh: : 这里发生的任何事，都会在比赛结束的那一刻……不复存在。而过程中留下的任何回忆，都归你们自己所有。

lines.zh: : 我在踢打……在哭……可他一直打我……

lines.en: : He keeps...violating me...
lines.zh: : 他不停地……侵犯我……

lines.en: scene meetandfuck30
: Then...finally...it seems like someone is coming to rescue me...
lines.zh: : 然后……终于……好像有人来救我了……

lines.en: : But it’s actually just a group of his friends and-
lines.zh: : 但那其实只是他的一群朋友，然后——

lines.en: : Shh...
: I think that’s as good a place as any to stop.
lines.zh: : 我觉得，停在这里再合适不过了。

lines.en: scene black
: Are you kidding?! That’s where we’re going to stop?! That was like the worst place to stop! We didn’t even get to hear the end!
lines.zh: : 你在开玩笑吧？！我们居然要停在这儿？！这简直是最糟糕的停顿点！我们连结尾都没听到！

lines.en: : Yes, but this just means we get to come up with our own ending.
lines.zh: : 没错，但这恰好意味着我们可以自己编一个结局。

lines.en: : Besides, we have two other games to play. And, should you be chosen, you’ll soon find that indulging any further may just work against you...
lines.zh: : 再说，我们还有另外两场游戏要玩。而且，如果你被选中的话，很快就会发现，继续沉溺下去反而可能对你不利……

lines.en: Nodokathon Round 1: Complete
lines.zh: Nodokathon 第一轮：结束

lines.en: Winner: Sana Sakakibara
lines.zh: 胜者：Sana Sakakibara

lines.en: Meanwhile...
lines.zh: 与此同时……
